items.text: “Kiswamau arupepen aarei nuka epuesa; kiswamau ka loerukuk: itwasamai kes kanuka anyaraununena ekodet, ido kanuka alosit anyoun kaneidukurete.
Ido naekutanakinere kes, etukokin ekodet kere mama ijai kokek loka ewema loka airiamunun.
Konye arai kekutakin adiopet, etukokinos ikapolok luepolokinito ilukumin luka Isirael mama ijai.
Ido naikutakiniata naka elulu, enyounete iruna lukoidukurun luka ari nakokide alosit.
Naikutakiniata da naka elulu nakiareit, enyounete iruna lukoidukurun luka ari naka eŋalakimak alosit: ekutanakinete aikwenyar kanuka alositokee.
Konye naekotokinere arukokin ekodet nepepe, ikutanakinete, konye mam ikutakinete naka elulu.
Odwe luka Aaron, isasedotin, kes ekutanakinete arupepen; ido eraunos ŋun ekisil kamakus ikar kere anatar aturiokus kere.
Ido nailosioto aitiji lokasurup lokimwanit yes kakwapukus, ŋes ikutakiniata naka elulu karupepen; kiitunio yes kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT Ekusideke, kitaiario da yes kakonyen nuka lukasurupokus.

Kapaaran da naka aiyalamakus, kopucinokus lueseunitai, kotoma ailamunun da naka ilapiokus, ikutaaakinete arupepen kainakinetakus nuieweio, kasuban da nuka ainakineta nuka ainapakin; eraunos da kamakus aisiitunet kakonyen nuka Edekekus: arai eoŋ EJAKAIT Ekusideke.”
Kosodi kokaru lokiareit, kolap lokiareit, kapaaran naka akaisaarei, aponi kolemarai edou kokuiu owema lokalaunan laka aiteienunet.
Kobwota idwe luka Isirael kwape ajaatar alositokec anyoun kamodiŋ naka Sinai; kosipokin edou amodiŋ naka Paran,
Kogeut alositekee kwape ajaar aicorakinet naka EJAKAIT kama ka Musa.
Kisiaununei emedera loka iidukurun luka idwe luka Yuda aitobwosio kwape ajaatar irionetakec: ido loapolokinit erioneteke ŋes Nason okoku loka Aminadab.
Ido loapolokinit erioŋet laka ateker naka idwe luka Isakar ŋes Netanel okoku loka Suar.
Loapolokinit erioŋet loka ateker naka idwe luka Sebulun ŋes Eliab okoku loka Kelon.
Koutoi iloin konunukai da ewema lokalaunan; kobwota odwe luka Gereson ka odwe luka Merari luadakenenete ewema lokalaunan.
Kitobwotai emedera loka iidukurun luka Reuben kwape ajaatar irionetakec: loapolokinit da erioneteke ŋes Elisur okoku loka Sedeur.
Loapolokinit erioŋet loka ateker naka idwe luka Simeon ŋes Selumiel okoku laka Surisadai.
Loapolokinit erioŋet loka ateker naka idwe luka Gad ŋes. Eliasap okoku loka Deuel.
Kobwota Ikokatin, kibwokito da iboro luka aibois nakalaunan: ebubuonokinete kwi ewema lokalaunan eriŋa kes kedolo,
Kitobwotai emedera loka iidukurun luka idwe luka Epuraim kwape ajaatar irionetakec: loapolokinit da erioneteke ŋes Elisama okoku loka Amikud,
Loapolokinit erioŋet loka ateker naka idwe luka Manase ŋes Gamaliel okoku loka Pedasur.
Loapolokinit erioŋet loka ateker naka idwe luka Benyamin ŋes Abidan okoku loka Gideoni.
Kitobwotai emedera loka iidukurun luka idwe luka Dan loewasie koidukurun kere, kwape ajaatar irionetakec: loapolokinit da erioneteke ŋes Akieser okoku loka Amisadai.
Loapolokinit erioŋet loka ateker naka idwe luka Aser ŋes Pagiel okoku loka Oeuran.
Loapolokinit erioŋet loka ateker naka idwe luka Naputali ŋes Akira okoku loka Enan.
Ekonenenei nen alosit naka idwe luka Isirael kwape ajaatar irionetakec; kobwota.

Kolimok Musa omuranike Kobab, okoku loka Reuel Emidianit ebe, “Kibei isio aibois naabu Edeke kobala ebe, ‘Kainakini yes’: kaupakinos, ka sio da kiswamakini jo ejok: naarai ener EJAKAIT nuejok nuka Isirael.”
Kotema ŋes atiar, “Mam alosi; konye aboŋori bukosi, mama ejai atekereka.”
Kotema atiar, “Sirikiinyei sio, kenainait; naarai iieni kwape kilosio aidukur toma amodiŋ, kwaŋin iraun ijo akosikonye.
Ejaun kwanata, arai kiupakin oni, eebo ejaun kwanata ebe, niniiokis kere nakiswamakini sic EJAKAIT, nipenin kiswamakini isio da jo.”
Kobwota anyoun komoru loka EJAKAIT alosit naka apaarasia auni; kiŋarenikinite kes asaduku naka aitutuket naka EJAKAIT kalosite naka apaarasia auni, amoikin kes aibois nakiyenunet,
Korapiarite kes edou loka EJAKAIT paaran naabwosiata koidukurun.
Kosodi naetobwosenenere asaduku kotemanari Musa atiar, “Konyou, wu EJAKAIT, kisiarisiar lukasurupokon; kokerata da lukilaito jo kakonyenekon.”
Naeyenununa da kotemanari atiar, “Koboŋu, wu EJAKAIT, neejaas ilukumin itomon luka ilukumin luka Isirael.”
